name: backfill
description: Targeted re-calibration: focused re-capture for L5 monitor-verdict tensors. Reads the monitor-verdict rows from the DB, dispatches one per-tensor subprocess per row, and writes the per-tensor activation stats back to the DB with source='backfill_real' and backfill_count incremented.

db.description: Path to the unified tessera.duckdb file.

model_hash.description: Model hash for the monitor-verdict lookup.

corpus_root.description: Path to the calibration corpus root.

max_backfill_rounds.description: Maximum number of backfill rounds per monitor-verdict tensor (default 2).

backfill_sample_cap.description: Per-tensor sample cap for the backfill re-capture (default 256).

component.description: Per-role component path as ROLE=PATH (trunk, dflash, dspark, mtp_nextn, shared_embd, vision_tower, audio_tower, mm_projector). Repeatable. Text-side roles take a layers directory; mmproj roles take a GGUF path.

output.description: Path to the sidecar JSON (llama.tessera.backfill.v1). Defaults to stdout when omitted.
